values.actions: Run one free skills workshop for students. Three organisers are available, but names and dates are not agreed.
values.boundaries: Use the available campus room. No spending has been approved.

suggestions.actions: Organise a skills workshop for students, define the topic and format. Confirm the availability of the campus room and agree on a date. Assign roles for promotion and logistics.
suggestions.boundaries: Ensure no budget is exceeded and all activities are contained within the campus facilities.
suggestions.check: If the room is not available or if spending is required, pause the planning until these issues are resolved.
suggestions.review: Bring records of the workshop plan, including the topic, date, and promotional materials, to review the final details and confirm execution.

questions: What specific skills will the workshop focus on?
What is the target number of students for the workshop?
output.note: Clarifying the workshop topic and target audience will help in planning and promoting the event effectively.

values.observations: Two reports were delivered. One customer replied positively. The other has not replied. Time spent producing each report was not recorded.

context.label: Expected evidence
context.value: Understand customer value and the effort needed to produce reports before deciding on a larger rollout.

suggestions.observations: Two reports were delivered. One customer replied positively. The other has not replied. Time spent producing each report was not recorded.
suggestions.difference: No expectation was recorded for the response rate or time spent on report production, making comparison unavailable.
suggestions.learning: The positive response from one customer indicates potential value in the reports, but the lack of response from the other customer leaves uncertainty about overall reception and effort required.
suggestions.nexttest: Record the time spent producing each report to better understand the effort involved.

questions: What is the expected response rate from customers?
Is there a specific timeframe for when you expect replies from customers?
output.note: Understanding the time spent on report production will help assess the effort relative to customer feedback.
